question: best natural sources of calcium
plausible_answers: Leafy greens: boiled collards (~358 mg/cup), kale, bok choy, Swiss chard, turnip greens
Calcium-fortified plant-based foods: soy milk, calcium-set tofu, fortified juice and cereal
